Search by when they went out, what they were about, how severe and how urgent, and the area they covered. Tests and exercises are left out unless you ask for them. This is a historical archive, not a live feed.

description: Look up official US disaster information from FEMA's open data. Find the federal disasters declared for any state or county since 1953 and what each one unlocked, then follow the money: the rebuilding projects FEMA funded, the grants that went to households, and the work paid for to reduce the damage next time. Check whether a community takes part in the National Flood Insurance Program, how many of its homes carry flood insurance, and what has been paid out there before. Search the archive of public emergency alerts, and see which federal agencies were sent in. Dates come back as plain dates, money in dollars, and FEMA's internal codes as words. No account or API key is required.
